name: Mixed Media Slide
description: Image or accessible video slide with responsive art direction and an optional safe editorial call to action. Use only inside a Mixed Media Carousel.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Mixed Media Slide
attribute_definition_groups.description: Image or accessible video slide with responsive art direction and an optional safe editorial call to action. Use only inside a Mixed Media Carousel.

attribute_definitions.name: Media type
attribute_definitions.description: Field: mediaType

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop image
attribute_definitions.description: Primary image used when Media type is Image.

attribute_definitions.name: Mobile image
attribute_definitions.description: Optional alternate crop displayed below the tablet breakpoint.

attribute_definitions.name: Image alternative text
attribute_definitions.description: Describe informative imagery. Leave empty only when Decorative image is enabled.

attribute_definitions.name: Decorative image
attribute_definitions.description: Hides the image from assistive technology when adjacent copy conveys the same meaning.

attribute_definitions.name: Prioritize image loading
attribute_definitions.description: Enable only for the first above-the-fold slide. Other slides remain lazy-loaded.

attribute_definitions.name: Video URL
attribute_definitions.description: Secure YouTube, Vimeo, MP4, WebM or Ogg URL used when Media type is Video.

attribute_definitions.name: Accessible video title
attribute_definitions.description: Required when Media type is Video.

attribute_definitions.name: Video poster
attribute_definitions.description: Field: posterImage

attribute_definitions.name: WebVTT captions URL
attribute_definitions.description: Optional captions for direct video files.

attribute_definitions.name: Captions language
attribute_definitions.description: Optional BCP 47 language code. Leave empty to use the current storefront locale.

attribute_definitions.name: Transcript URL
attribute_definitions.description: Field: transcriptUrl

attribute_definitions.name: Click to play
attribute_definitions.description: Defers third-party video loading until the shopper activates it.

attribute_definitions.name: Media aspect ratio
attribute_definitions.description: Field: aspectRatio

attribute_definitions.name: Eyebrow
attribute_definitions.description: Field: eyebrow

attribute_definitions.name: Title
attribute_definitions.description: Field: title

attribute_definitions.name: Body
attribute_definitions.description: Field: body

attribute_definitions.name: Heading level
attribute_definitions.description: Choose the level that follows the surrounding page heading hierarchy.

attribute_definitions.name: Content placement
attribute_definitions.description: Overlay is available for image slides; video content is always displayed below the player.

attribute_definitions.name: Content alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Field: contentAlignment

attribute_definitions.name: CTA label
attribute_definitions.description: Field: ctaLabel

attribute_definitions.name: CTA destination
attribute_definitions.description: Field: ctaUrl
